name: netnewswire-mcp
description: Read-only access to your NetNewsWire feeds, articles, and search index.
long_description: Reads NetNewsWire's local SQLite databases in read-only mode. Claude (the desktop app) needs Full Disk Access to read the NetNewsWire app container: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Full Disk Access.

tools.description: Starred articles with optional feed filter
